title: Google Lets Non-Programmers Publish Private Android Apps to Play Store

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
AI Studio now allows people without any software engineering background to build mobile applications at no cost and install them on their hardware. Individuals with a standard Google account can deploy these creations via Google Play, though the apps remain completely private to the owner's device for the time being.

This shift toward "vibe coding" allows users to create and maintain software through generative AI instead of writing manual code. Google will add a feature to share these private applications with friends in the coming months.
